service.name: scenario-to-ios
service.description: Turn any Vrooli scenario into a distributable iOS application with evidence-backed validation on simulators and physical devices.

vrooli-bridge.purpose: Reach plane for the macOS node that performs every build, simulator run, and physical-device session. No Apple toolchain runs on Linux, so remote execution is this ramp's normal path rather than a fallback.
vrooli-bridge.degraded_behavior: Every native iOS target reports unavailable carrying the reach reason. Linux-host rows remain unsupported, which is a different and terminal state that must not be collapsed into unavailable.

device-control.purpose: Every device verb under a held lease, across the ios-simctl, ios-xcuitest, and ios-mirror strategies. This ramp implements no device driving of its own.
device-control.degraded_behavior: Journey cells report unavailable naming device-control as the missing capability. The ramp never drives simctl or a device directly, because that would bypass leases and audit — and the mirroring strategy is physically single-session, so a missing lease guarantees corruption.

deployment-manager.purpose: Consumes this ramp's reference-only common.v1.TargetVerdict and owns the cross-ramp release gate.
deployment-manager.degraded_behavior: The local gate still computes and evidence is retained; verdict emission retries. Evidence is never discarded because the consumer is down.

browser-automation-studio.purpose: Executes a scenario's own named web-content flows against the generated app's WKWebView, so an author writes a flow once and it replays on iOS unchanged.
browser-automation-studio.degraded_behavior: Web-content chapters report unavailable; native shell chapters still execute and the run reports partial honestly rather than passing.

backdrop-studio.purpose: Provides the typed backdrop composition contract used by the iOS journey adapter for scenario-owned web-content flows.
backdrop-studio.degraded_behavior: Journey web-content chapters report unavailable with the missing backdrop capability; the ramp never silently replaces the typed client.

secrets-manager.purpose: Holds certificates, provisioning profiles, and App Store Connect API keys by reference so no signing material exists in this repository, in a generated project, or in evidence.
secrets-manager.degraded_behavior: Builds requiring a signed artifact report unavailable naming the enrollment or certificate rung. The ramp never generates an ad-hoc signing identity as a fallback.

hello-mobile.purpose: Conformance fixture. The ramp must be provable end to end without depending on any product scenario's correctness, and it is simultaneously the transport-symmetry proof because it builds on a remote node.
hello-mobile.degraded_behavior: The ramp's own conformance proof cannot run. Product scenario deliveries are unaffected.
